title: About This Portfolio
text: This site documents statistical programming work performed using the pharmaverse — an open-source R ecosystem for clinical trial data analysis. It serves as both a learning resource and a demonstration of reproducible clinical reporting workflows.

title: About This Portfolio
text:
Environment
All analyses are run inside the statprog_environment/ directory, which follows a standard statistical programming folder hierarchy:



Folder
Contents




data/raw/
Original source data


data/sdtm/
SDTM datasets


data/adam/
ADaM datasets (CDISC Pilot)


pgms/
Analysis programs (R scripts / QMD)


outputs/
Generated TLF outputs


logs/
Execution logs


metadata/
Specifications and data dictionaries

title: About This Portfolio
text:
Dataset
The CDISC Pilot Project dataset is used throughout. It is a publicly available reference dataset distributed by CDISC that mirrors a real Phase III Alzheimer’s disease clinical trial.

title: Pharmaverse Clinical Reporting Portfolio
text:
This portfolio demonstrates end-to-end clinical reporting workflows built on the pharmaverse ecosystem — a curated collection of open-source R packages designed for clinical trial data analysis and submission-ready reporting.
Work is based on the CDISC Pilot Project dataset, a publicly available reference dataset that mirrors real Phase III trial data structures (SDTM and ADaM).
